title: Presenting
about: Presenting: the display stays on, the desktop and Dock are out of the way, nothing pops up in a corner, and Overbright lifts the built-in display to 130%. `knobs undo` puts all of it back. Do Not Disturb is not included: Focus has no setting Knobs can write and read back. To place your slides window too, see examples/present-keynote.knobs.json.
about.zh: 演示模式:屏幕不熄灭,桌面和程序坞让开,角落不会突然弹出东西,Overbright 把内建屏幕提亮到 130%。`knobs undo` 全部还原。不包含勿扰模式:专注模式没有 Knobs 能写入并回读确认的设置。想把幻灯片窗口也摆好,参考 examples/present-keynote.knobs.json。
